title: Route catalogue: every way to use a repository, read from its indexed snapshot (no sandbox)
description: Produced by catalogue.py (route-catalogue-spec.md section 2): RULES find entry points, manifests, Makefile targets, compose files and CI workflows with their source lines; ONE model call groups, titles and writes the one-sentence outcome and the requirements. `practical`, `effort`, `reason`, `recommended`, the order of `routes` and `more` are computed by the controller from the requirements (catalogue.derive), never by the model: the model-facing copy of this schema (catalogue.model_schema) leaves them out, and any it sends anyway is overwritten. Nothing in the catalogue exists without a rule-found source: every stepsSketch[].source is one of the candidates the rules found. VALIDATION (checked by catalogue.py, then one re-ask with the errors, else failed no_catalogue): schema-valid; exactly one route has recommended true among the practical routes (none when there are no practical routes); titles are at most 70 characters and contain no file path, no command and no file:line (those belong in stepsSketch); at most 8 practical routes, the rest listed in `more`. Cost is a label, never a number: effort is one of the six labels below. A route whose requirements the hardware class cannot meet has practical false and a plain-words `reason`; it is shown as text in the chat, never as a chip. Cached in R2 at learn-repositories-dev/<appId>/<commit>/catalogue-<hardware>.json.

summary.description: one or two plain sentences: what the repository is. No path, command or file:line.

learn.description: What a learner can study here (intake-run-or-learn-spec section 2). Written by catalogue.add_learn: ONE model call after the routes, or alone on a stored document that has none (the routes are kept; no version bump). Enforced by catalogue.learn_clean: 1-4 options, every anchor exists in the snapshot, no path or file name in a label, kinds unique, an option whose anchors are all under docs/ dropped; nothing surviving gives one default structure option. `cannot` names what the repository does not have, for the scoped router. Optional: a document made before it has none.

label.description: at most 6 words, no path or file name

what.description: one sentence: what the learner would understand

anchors.description: paths (or directories) in the snapshot where the topic lives

more.description: practical routes beyond the cap of 8: shown as a plain line under the list

source.description: path:line or path:line-line, a rule-found location

title.description: the outcome in the person's words (what they will see happen); no path, command or file:line

description.description: one sentence of what happens; no path, command or file:line

reason.description: required when practical is false: why it cannot run here, as a requirement (needs a GPU), never as a failure

downloadGB.description: download beyond pip packages, in GB

downloadHosts.description: hostnames the route downloads from (data, weights, tools); the controller checks them against the sandbox allowlist

accounts.description: accounts, API keys or credentials the route needs

platform.description: only when the route is limited to one operating system, e.g. macos

evidence.description: a rule-found source for each requirement claimed

prerequisites.description: routeIds this route depends on; their steps are inlined as this route's first steps when it is rehearsed
